in_sanskrit.name: Dau
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dau एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dāu’, which means ‘water’. This name is often given to babies born near or during the monsoon season, as it symbolizes the purifying and cleansing power of water.
